name: Kasumi K. Kasumi
source:
Kasumi K. Kasumi is [url=/c14679]Maria Custard[/url]'s assistant and student. She usually appears in scenes where Maria is working on Tulip. Like her teacher she's clumsy but very loyal and faithful. She's very shy and innocent, and brushes aside Rance's advancements on her. She's the Deputy Director of the Maria Factory and is in charge of the management and administrative affairs. Her clothes and looks are similar to Maria but has a short black hair instead.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kasumi_K._Kasumi]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
